options.name: get_functions
options.description: List of pre-built functions that retrieve data for the 'hostvars_inventory_hostname'/'msg_vpn' data in 'hostvars'.

options.name: hostvars
options.description: The playbook's 'hostvars'. Contains all facts for all hosts / brokers. Always set to: 'hostvars: "{{ hostvars }}"

options.name: hostvars_inventory_hostname
options.description: The 'inventory_hostname', i.e. the playbook's host, to retrieve the facts from as available in 'hostvars'.

options.name: msg_vpn
options.description: The message vpn of the broker to retrieve the facts from. Only required for certain 'get_functions' if more than 1 Vpn exists. Can be omitted if only 1 Vpn exists.
